---
title: "Sources"
---

Every source the pipeline touches, from the
[source registry](https://github.com/liumOazed/public-data-intelligence/blob/main/sources/registry.yaml).
Green sources are free, programmatic and stable. Amber sources are public but awkward, or
their reuse terms still need reading. Raw responses are never published; only derived tables
and charts are, with attribution.

```{python}
from IPython.display import Markdown

from pdi import site

Markdown(site.registry_table().drop(columns=["id"]).to_markdown(index=False))
```

"Unconfirmed" under *Terms last read* means nobody has read that source's terms yet and the
entry was written from memory. Those need reading before the pages built on them are shared
widely.
